resources.string: Use the agent on your computer from your phone.
On your computer, open unoblox works and choose Connect Phone.
Tap Scan QR code and point your camera at the code.
Your phone talks to your computer directly. The agent and your files stay there.
You will need to scan its QR code again to use it from this phone.
On your computer, Connect Phone shows the link under the QR code.
This is not an unoblox works pairing code. On your computer, choose Connect Phone and scan the code it shows.
Scan the code on your computer
In unoblox works on your computer, choose Connect Phone.
To scan the code, allow camera access in Settings. You can also paste the pairing link instead.
The camera could not be started. You can paste the pairing link instead.
Check that the computer is awake, unoblox works is open, and your phone is on the same Wi-Fi.
Internet links stop working when the computer turns the link off or restarts it. On your computer, choose Connect Phone and scan the new code.
Codes work once, for five minutes. On your computer, choose Connect Phone and scan the new code.
